prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / coherent website world key art.
Create the COMPLETE SCHOOL PLAZA WORLD for TOKKATSU広場, based on the approved four ORIGINAL mascots in the reference image. Reference role: STRICT CHARACTER IDENTITY AND MATERIAL/STYLE GUIDE. Preserve these four faces, hair silhouettes, original small noses, dark oval eyes, bare hands, costumes, color roles and props. No Mario gloves or Mario noses.
Deliver one finished high-resolution WIDE 2:1 landscape illustration, ideally 3072 x 1536 or larger: one CONTINUOUS CONNECTED school campus with four activity scenes, NOT a collage, no vertical dividers, no panels, no headings or typography, no text anywhere, no logo or watermark. Beautiful art direction suitable as the main website hero, immediately inviting to teachers and children. The four foreground scenes must be easy to read even without labels. Natural eye-level / moderately elevated three-quarter viewpoint, NOT distant aerial miniature. Camera close enough for clear faces. Common ground, continuous footpaths and consistent sunlight. Four principal characters are LARGE, full-body, about 28-34% of total image height, foreground; 2 supporting pupils per activity slightly smaller but still expressive. Around 12 people TOTAL, no decorative distant crowds, no hidden hands. Every character and prop safely within frame with breathing room.

STYLE:
Use exactly the reference's warm polished stylized 3D original game-mascot aesthetic for EVERYTHING: rounded and gently beveled architectural edges, sculptural single-mass trees, simple puffy clouds, soft matte surfaces, clean broad highlights/shadows, rich forest green/vermilion/school blue/golden yellow and warm cream. Character heads about 2.7-heads-tall proportion, dark simple eyes, small noses, expressive brows and smiles, bare skin hands, sensible rounded strap shoes. No realistic children, no hair strands, no fuzzy textures, no shiny plastic, no clay grain, no dramatic bokeh. Background detail restrained, clean intentional shape language, no visual clutter, no gridded chain-link fence. This is a warm ORIGINAL school world, not an existing game franchise; no mushrooms, pipes, coins, blocks, castles or franchise symbols.

LAYOUT:
Upper 35-40% establishes a friendly Japanese elementary school: cream three-story SCHOOL BUILDING with soft blue pitched roofs, large rectangular aqua windows with rounded corners, recognizable round CLOCK over the central entrance, plus a lower warm gymnasium. A few rounded broad trees and shrubs, small patches of grass. Pale blue sky and a few simple clouds in top 15-20%, no large empty white background. Continuous honey-sand schoolyard occupies middle/foreground, with gently curved cream walking paths linking four activity areas. Light consistent from upper left.
Scenes ordered LEFT TO RIGHT and occupy four roughly equal horizontal regions, but seamlessly connected through the campus:

LEFT QUARTER — CLASS MEETING / 学級活動:
An inviting open-front cutaway ground-floor classroom connected to school, three modest rounded desks form an OPEN semi-circle so faces visible. Forest-green 学活くん (same rounded dark hair, green tunic with short cream placket, green shorts and shoes, white note card with two green lines) facilitates, holding his little card and inviting a pupil to speak. One seated child raises hand and smiles, another writes notes while listening. Deep green chalkboard with orderly colored rectangular proposal cards, NO writing. Three characters total, attentive eye contact. Don't put teacher at front: child-led discussion. Large green mascot fully visible, not hidden behind a desk. Classroom has only partial side/back wall and a small low platform so integrated cutaway feels coherent.

SECOND QUARTER — SPORTS DAY / 学校行事:
Schoolyard curved WHITE RUNNING TRACK markings, short festive bunting, bright but sparse red-white event cues. Vermilion 行人 with signature white sports headband, white horizontal shirt stripe, orange shorts, orange/cream shoes and YELLOW triangular flag cheering a dynamic relay handoff by two children in red/white sports caps and PE kit. Clear leaning torsos, bent knees, baton handoff, visible happy faces. Place mascot beside the track in the foreground and the runners just behind him, so both activity and identity read. Three characters total.

THIRD QUARTER — STUDENT COUNCIL ASSEMBLY / 児童会活動:
School entrance plaza with a very low small wooden rounded stage, simple nearby noticeboard bearing colored symbol cards, no words. Blue 児童会ちゃん: preserve her two low round dark side buns, blue dress, YELLOW diagonal sash, compact blue shoes, handheld microphone. She speaks and welcomes with open free hand; two differently aged pupils respond, one raises a hand, the other helps hold a board displaying three simple colored shapes. All faces turned to each other AND viewer in three-quarter, no wall of backs-of-head, child leadership obvious, no adult. Three characters total, large mascot in foreground.

RIGHT QUARTER — CLUB ACTIVITIES / クラブ活動:
Sunny creative corner beside rounded leafy tree and low outdoor worktable. Yellow クラブマン: original blue headband, white five-point chest STAR outlined dark, short RED-ORANGE cape, yellow shorts and shoes. Happy celebratory gesture beside two children MAKING/EXPLORING: one paints a bright simple flower at a small easel, another builds a wooden toy glider at a low table. Clear paint palette/brush and model airplane communicate club activities. No laboratory dangerous substances; not another meeting or sports race. Three characters total, yellow mascot full-body at foreground, cape visible.

COMPOSITION QUALITY:
The scene should feel like a coherent inviting playful campus one wants to visit, with depth from overlapping building/tree masses and soft contact shadows. Faces and actions are focal points, buildings support storytelling. Full campus extends to frame edges naturally but all important people inside margin. No four huge mascots simply posing disconnected from activities: show them engaged with their group. Avoid tiny decorative clutter and repeated dolls. Preserve left-to-right green/red/blue/yellow rhythm. Editorially clean iconic readable illustration; no text on boards, signs, flags or clothing except the specified stripe and star shapes.
